description: Generate original misanthropic media and technology satire using extended grotesque metaphor, self-loathing narration, and premises that escalate one logical step at a time into a bleak, deflating conclusion.

queries.prompt: Write a cynical monologue tearing apart a reality TV show using one extended grotesque metaphor
I want a savage, self-loathing takedown of rolling news coverage
Write a short story where a new social media feature escalates logically into a nightmarish outcome, Black Mirror style but original
Give me a misanthropic bit mocking corporate tech jargon by translating it into what it actually means
Can you write something like a Charlie Brooker column but with entirely original wording and no copied material?
Write a piece about a gadget that starts mundane and builds into an increasingly violent metaphor before a flat, bleak ending
I need a dystopian near-future scenario about a phone app that follows a believable chain of consequences to a horrifying place
Write a documentary sketch where the presenter asks an expert a hopelessly ignorant question with total confidence
Write a stand-up bit about family dysfunction told in multiple character voices
Write a two-person deadpan political satire interview about a border policy
Write an observational stand-up bit about the difference between how men and women argue
What conventional commit type should I use for a bug fix?
Help me write an IAM policy for cross-account S3 access
